title: Important documents to keep
question: Which documents should I keep safe?
answer: Keep your passport, visa or permit, work contract, payslips, health insurance details, and important employer messages. Keep photos or scans as backup.

title: Passport held by someone else
question: Can my employer keep my passport?
answer: Your passport is your personal document. If someone is holding it and you cannot get it back, ask for help from a trusted organization or legal support.
